newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: DE BEERS RISES AMID FIRST HALF SALES NEWS.
newsitem.headline: DE BEERS RISES AMID FIRST HALF SALES NEWS.

text.p: Shares in diamond giant De Beers Consolidated Mines Ltd rose on Wednesday as the firm posted first half sales up 4.81 percent to $2.880 billion.
By 1130 GMT the firm's stock was up 100 cents to 166.50 rand.

The company said consumer trends indicated that U.S. demand was continuing to grow at a similar rate to last year, while Japan, the second largest market after the U.S., was still expected to have a difficult year.
It noted, however, that first quarter sales of diamond jewellery in Japan were up in advance of retail tax increases in April.
